entities.summary: Franz Hruschka, Franz von Hruschka, Francesco De Hruschka, František Hruška was an Austrian/Italian of Czech origin officer and beekeeper known as the inventor of the honey extractor, an invention he presented in 1865 at the Brno Beekeeper Conference.
